description: Énergies renouvelables en Région de Bruxelles-Capitale is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Brugel. Information on the number and capacity of green electricity production facilities in the Brussels-Capital Region. The three technologies present in the Brussels-Capital Region are Solar, Cogeneration and Steam Turbines coupled up to the Incinerator of the Brussels-Capital Region. Coverage: Brugel. The portal shows the English title as "Renewable energies in the Brussels-Capital Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Brugel. Its keywords include environment, Geografische namen, Energie, Geographical names, Énergie, Sources d'énergie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
